tagline: Solusi Stok FIFO, Voice Input Dapur, Simulator HPP, & Belanja Otomatis F&B

colors.rules: Use Emerald Green (#10B981) for primary actions, fresh inventory, and profit gains. Use Warning Amber (#F59E0B) for items nearing FIFO expiry (1-3 days). Use Danger Rose (#EF4444) for spoiled items, negative margin alerts, and critical stockouts. Dark Slate (#0F172A) serves as dark mode base and primary neutral font tint in light mode.

How-It-Works 4-Step Visual Process (Input -> Auto Batching -> Margin Protect -> Auto Reorder)

features: Preset Demo Credentials cards for instant one-click login ('Warung Makan', 'Coffee Shop', 'Catering Enterprise')

components: 4 KPI Cards: Total Nilai Stok, Bahan Mendekati Expired (Alert FIFO), Estimasi Hemat Sampah, Rata-Rata Margin HPP

AI Margin & Price Hike Simulator: Interactive range slider for ingredient price inflation (+5% to +50%), dynamic margin output, Rechart bar chart showing Before vs After profit impact, AI Recommendation Box ('Saran AI: Naikkan harga porsi Rp 2.000 atau kurangi porsi ayam 15 gram')
FIFO Inventory Batch Table: Sort by expiration, status badges (Merah <2 hari, Kuning 3-5 hari, Hijau >5 hari), batch ID, vendor info, action to use batch first
Voice-to-Stock Microphone input component with pulse wave animation

Preset Sample-Text Buttons beside mic button for 1-click test if mic permission is blocked in browser ('Masuk 15kg Daging Sapi Rp 110.000 exp 4 hari', 'Tambah 20L Minyak Goreng Rp 16.000 exp 30 hari', 'Stok Cabai Rawit 5kg Rp 70.000 exp lusa')
Receipt OCR Upload dropzone with simulated auto-extraction preview table
Dynamic HPP Recalculator showing Old HPP vs New HPP breakdown for popular dishes when raw material prices change
Sales POS CSV import & manual transaction entry
Quick Stock Take variance check form (System stock vs Physical count with discrepancy calculator)
Audit Trail & Waste Log with loss reason tags (Expired, Damaged, Spilled, Overcooked)
Predictive Stockout Timeline showing items run out date
WhatsApp Supplier Order Generator: auto-formats purchase order in Bahasa Indonesia with item list, quantities, delivery date, with Copy to Clipboard button and Direct WhatsApp API link button

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components are fully implemented with real React state, mock dynamic calculations, and responsive tables.
Add data-testid attributes to all key buttons, inputs, tabs, sliders, and modals.
Support dark and light mode seamlessly using Tailwind dark: classes and CSS variable toggling.
Include sample buttons next to voice input for judges to test LLM parsing with one click.
Ensure the Pitch Deck modal displays detailed slides about problem, solution, market size in Indonesia (64M MSMEs), business model, and AI architecture.
All copy must be in clear, professional Bahasa Indonesia standard for F&B business owners.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid='...' to all interactive elements, inputs, buttons, and summary text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use transparent backgrounds on headers or dropdowns. Always use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl or solid card backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Add hover transitions, scale-95 active effects, tab animations, and toast notifications via sonner.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.sonner_toast: Use sonner for success/error feedback when saving stock, running simulator, generating WA message, or resetting data.
